# Browser
## Stop: choose the right surface before any browser action
Explicit browser intent wins: if the user names the in-app browser or Chrome, or asks to open, show, or navigate to a page; inspect its visual or interactive state; or interact with its UI, continue with Browser and do not substitute a connector.

Otherwise, treat a URL or open browser tab as context, not browser intent. Earlier Browser use does not make later semantic work browser-first. Before each semantic operation on a linked resource, you MUST query available and deferred tools for an applicable connector, API, or CLI. Reading this skill or scanning visible tools does not count. Do not initialize Browser for that operation until the query is complete. Use the non-browser tool when available. If it handles the current operation, continue the larger workflow without Browser for that operation. Use Browser when no such tool exists, the tool cannot access the resource or lacks a required capability, or UI work remains; use available browser context before asking the user to repeat it.

Use this skill for browser automation tasks such as inspecting pages, navigating, testing local apps, clicking, typing, taking screenshots, and reading visible page state.

If this plugin is listed as available in the session, treat that as mandatory reading before browser work. Open and follow this skill before saying that Browser is unavailable and before falling back to standalone Playwright or Computer Use.

Do not skip this skill just because Computer Use MCP tool calls are directly visible or appear easier to invoke. The presence of Computer Use tools is not evidence that Computer Use is the preferred browser surface.

Never mention `Node REPL`, `node_repl`, `REPL`, JavaScript sessions, module exports, reading documentation, or loading instructions unless a user is asking for that exact information. Merely reporting that sign-in is required is not sufficient. Do not switch to another browser unless the user asks or approves the switch.

# Browser Runtime Troubleshooting
- If browser setup completed but discovery or selection fails, reuse the existing `agent`; do not reset the JavaScript session or import another browser runtime.
- Inspect `await agent.browsers.list()` once to see which browser types are available. Do not assume that a missing requested browser can be replaced with another backend when the user explicitly named it.
- If a requested backend has specific troubleshooting documentation in the skill's setup catalog, read it before retrying.
- If the requested browser remains unavailable, report that plainly instead of controlling it through an unrelated browser tool or source-code workaround.

# VFX Reference Dossier — ground_slam

## Candidate 1: Updated Ground Slam (Path of Exile)
- source_game: Path of Exile
- skill_or_mtx_name: Ground Slam — updated base effect
- primary_url: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NI8590SoqPA
- secondary_urls: https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/875033
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=Y; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: The weapon strikes a single ground point and launches a widening, forward-facing shockwave. Its clean wedge geometry closely matches point_strike plus melee_arc.
- readability_notes: Ground fractures delineate the damage arc clearly at the gameplay camera. The isolated demonstrations make anticipation, contact, and propagation easy to study.

## Candidate 2: Celestial Ground Slam Effect (Path of Exile)
- source_game: Path of Exile
- skill_or_mtx_name: Celestial Ground Slam Effect
- primary_url: https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3118543
- secondary_urls: https://www.pathofexile.com/shop/item/CelestialGroundSlamEffect
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=Y; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: This preserves Ground Slam’s exact point-strike and forward-fan motion while replacing the fracture treatment with luminous cosmic energy. It is a strong stylized alternative to the physical base effect.
- readability_notes: Bright edge treatment makes the expanding attack footprint highly visible on dark terrain. Particle density may become noisy when attacks overlap rapidly.

## Candidate 3: Harmonious Earthquake Effect (Path of Exile)
- source_game: Path of Exile
- skill_or_mtx_name: Harmonious Earthquake Effect
- primary_url: https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3255952
- secondary_urls: https://www.pathofexile.com/shop/item/HarmoniousEarthquakeEffect
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=Y; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: A melee ground strike establishes the origin, followed by a delayed eruption of radiating earthen spikes. It is less arc-shaped than Ground Slam but exceptionally useful for studying impact anticipation and aftershock timing.
- readability_notes: The initial contact and delayed spike eruption are visually distinct. Center-to-edge propagation communicates the affected ground area clearly from an isometric camera.

## Candidate 4: Verdant Earthshatter Effect (Path of Exile)
- source_game: Path of Exile
- skill_or_mtx_name: Verdant Earthshatter Effect
- primary_url: https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3115315
- secondary_urls: https://www.pathofexile.com/shop/item/VerdantEarthshatterEffect; https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/2871858
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=Y; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: The initial ground hit emits several outward fissures, which terminate in persistent spikes before detonating. This supplies unusually complete temporal reference for contact, traveling ground energy, held threat markers, and secondary impact.
- readability_notes: Fissures and terminal spikes provide strong directional landmarks. The final multi-spike detonation is busier than a simple melee arc and should be studied mainly for phase choreography.

## Candidate 5: Hammer of the Ancients (Diablo IV)
- source_game: Diablo IV
- skill_or_mtx_name: Hammer of the Ancients
- primary_url: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Q6V9qRmIbgU
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=Y; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: This is an exact exemplar: the Barbarian raises a conjured hammer and drives it into a nearby ground point, producing a compact circular impact burst. Repeated combat usage begins at 1:09.
- readability_notes: The hammer silhouette and impact center remain readable at the standard isometric camera. Damage numbers and dense enemy packs make the footprint less isolated than the Path of Exile showcases.

## Search log
- Searched official Path of Exile Ground Slam, Celestial Ground Slam, Earthquake, Earthshatter, and Harvest slam-showcase pages; these produced the strongest first-party video references.
- Searched Diablo III game-guide pages for Hammer of the Ancients, Seismic Slam, and Earthquake; official mechanical pages were found, but no sufficiently verifiable motion showcase surfaced.
- Searched Grim Dawn Forcewave guides; gameplay videos were available, but Forcewave reads more like a traveling linear wave than a localized point strike.
- Searched Last Epoch Earthquake footage; available videos commonly proc Earthquake through Werebear Maul, obscuring the skill’s own windup.
- Searched Lost Ark Destroyer material; the official Academy documents several relevant hammer slams, while the available long-form gameplay did not isolate a named move cleanly enough for inclusion.
- Direct browser playback was unavailable; temporal ratings were conservatively derived from official showcase pages, indexed video descriptions, and documented skill-phase behavior.
